Bug_Details: This checker errors on calls to java.time methods using values that are guaranteed to throw a DateTimeException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where an invalid month (13) and day (32) are used to create a LocalDate instance. The LocalDate.of method will throw a DateTimeException if the month is less than 1 or greater than 12, or if the day is less than 1 or greater than the length of the month.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug() method in the InvalidJavaTimeConstantBugTest class calls the showBug() method in the InvalidJavaTimeConstantBug class. This method attempts to create a LocalDate instance with an invalid month (13) and day (32), which causes the bug to be triggered and the test to fail.
